steps.description: Review test cases and ensure all tests are up-to-date.
Prepare environment for testing by installing necessary software and dependencies.
Execute automated tests using continuous integration (CI) tools like Jenkins or GitLab CI.
Manually run regression tests and unit tests to catch any regressions introduced during automation.
Analyze test results and identify failures or discrepancies.
Create detailed reports summarizing test findings and identifying bugs or issues.
Collate documentation related to changes made since the last review cycle.
Submit bug fixes and enhancements to the development team.
Maintain version control logs and update release notes accordingly.
Ensure compliance with project standards and guidelines regarding documentation practices.
Schedule meetings with stakeholders and developers.
Participate actively in discussions about upcoming features and roadmaps.
Provide feedback on proposed changes and suggest improvements.
Follow up on meeting outcomes and track progress towards agreed-upon goals.
Keep relevant documents updated with meeting minutes and action items.
Subscribe to industry news and updates through newsletters, blogs, and social media.
Engage with forums, communities, and online groups related to your field.
Read technical articles and whitepapers to stay current with best practices and emerging technologies.
Monitor GitHub repositories and other open-source projects for potential contributions.
Regularly assess personal skills and knowledge gaps to enhance proficiency.
